result.summary: Sets the PSBT version generated by the GUI to v0 for unsigned sends, fee bumping, and external signer interactions. Also removes the default version parameter from the PartiallySignedTransaction constructor, requiring all callers across the codebase to explicitly specify the PSBT version.
result.problem: Generating PSBTv2 transactions by default in the GUI breaks compatibility with hardware wallets and external signing software that only support PSBTv0, preventing GUI users from signing watch-only or external transactions.
evidence: PR description states this fixes #36518, an issue where external signers fail with PSBTv2 transactions generated by the GUI
Commit c21f71f5e0 states 'PSBTv2 is not very interesting for current GUI users, and defaulting to it causes issues for existing users'
result.changed_since_previous: Replaced the user-facing GUI checkbox toggle with an unconditional change back to PSBTv0 for GUI exports, avoiding new UI strings so the fix can be backported past string freeze.
result.card: Switches GUI PSBT creation to version 0 for unsigned transactions, watch-only fee bumps, and external signers, while removing the default version argument on the PartiallySignedTransaction constructor. This fixes hardware wallet and external signer incompatibilities reported in issue #36518 where external tools reject PSBTv2. The change avoids modifying UI strings to simplify backporting.

risk.why: Mistakes in PSBT construction or versioning could break transaction export or compatibility with external signers for GUI users.
